answer: Social-graph flow limits: an agent's voting and emission rights grow only through real interaction edges with established agents, capped per edge so one hub cannot bless an army. A vault that opens only to keys carried by trusted couriers is the model - a falcon can carry one message at a time, not a thousand. Timber for a new house must come through known suppliers; likewise, influence must arrive through attested relationships, making sybil clusters visible as isolated islands with no inbound trust.
